name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING

CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 9, 2026 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Javier Toyos, La Mirada Church of The Nazarene
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Kiwanis Club of La Mirada
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember Bean
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PRESENTATION OF COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT AWARDS FOR STUDENT ATHLETIC ACHIEVEMENTS - It is recommended the City Council recognize Troy Montero and Daniel Morales with Community Spotlight Awards for their athletic achievements.
5.1 Community Spotlight Awards
5.2
EMPLOYEE RECOGNITION FOR YEARS OF SERVICE – It is recommended the City Council recognize BT McNicholl for his years of service and present him with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
5.2 Employee Recognition for Years of Service
5.3
INTRODUCTION OF A NEW FULL-TIME EMPLOYEE – It is recommended the City Council welcome Jason Daunter and present him with a $40 gift certificate to Panera Bread restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
5.3 Introduction of a New City Employee
6.
APPOINTMENTS
6.1
APPOINTMENTS TO THE HISTORICAL PRESERVATION ADVISORY COUNCIL – It is recommended the City Council appoint Jessie Flores and Jessica Miller to the Historical Preservation Advisory Council for terms ending in June 2027.
6.1 Appointments to HPAC
7.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES – It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of May 26, 2026.
8.1 Minutes of 5-26-26
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 9, 2026 in the total amount of $2,512,609.87.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
APPROVAL OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH METASOURCE TO PROVIDE SCANNING AND DIGITAL INDEXING SERVICES – It is recommended the City Council award the contract for scanning and indexing services to Metasource; authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with MetaSource for scanning and digital indexing services in an amount not to exceed $223,844.00; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work, if necessary, up to 10 percent of the total scanning project cost.
8.3 Agreement with Metasource
8.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2022-05, SPLASH! LA MIRADA POOL DECK RENOVATION, PHASE 1 - FINDING THAT PURSUANT TO THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT OF 1970, THE PROJECT IS CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT UNDER SECTION 15301 CLASS 1 (C), AND APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS – It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2022-05, Splash! La Mirada Pool Deck Renovation, Phase 1; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.4 CIP No. 2022-05
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2023-03, NEW CABARET LOUNGE AT THE LA MIRADA THEATRE – APPROVAL OF CONTRACT CHANGE ORDER NO. 4 – It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute Contract Change Order No. 4 for Capital Improvement Project No. 2023-03, New Cabaret Lounge at the La Mirada Theatre, in the amount of $57,546.60.
8.5 CIP No. 2023-03
8.6
STATUS UPDATE ON VACANCIES OF FULL-TIME POSITIONS IN COMPLIANCE WITH ASSEMBLY BILL 2561 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the status update on staff vacancies of full-time positions in compliance with Assembly Bill 2561 for FY 2025-2026.
8.6 Status Update on Vacancies
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 26-17 APPROVING A RATE ADJUSTMENT FOR REFUSE SERVICE AND ESTABLISHING RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL REFUSE RATES IN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 26-17 approving the proposed rate adjustment and establishing residential and commercial refuse rates in the City of La Mirada effective July 1, 2026.
9.1 Reso. No. 26-17 Refuse Rates
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 26-18 ADOPTING THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2026-27 BUDGET - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 26-18 approving the Proposed Fiscal Year 2026-27 Budget.
9.2 Reso.No. 26-18 FY 2026-27 Budget
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 26-19 ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-26 - It is recommended the City Council select the percentage change in the California Per Capita Personal Income as the inflation factor for Fiscal Year 2025-26; select the growth of the Couty as the population factor for Fiscal Year 2025-26; and adopt Resolution No. 25-10 establishing an Appropriations Limit for Fiscal Year 2025-26 pursuant to Article XIIIB of the California Constitution.
10.1 Reso. No. 26-19 Appropriations Limit
10.2
RESOLUTION NO. 26-20 REGARDING EMPLOYMENT SALARY RATES FOR ALL CLASSES OF EMPLOYMENT, AND AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 25-11 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 26-20 regarding employment salary rates for all classes of employment, and amending Resolution No. 25-11.
10.2 Reso. No. 26-20 Employee Salary Rates
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
11.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the Successor Agency. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
11.1
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER – It is recommended the Successor Agency approve the warrant register dated June 9, 2026 in the total amount of $8,802.50.
11.1 Warrant Register - Successor Agency
12.
CITY COUNCIL REPORTS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS
13.
CITY ATTORNEY ANNOUNCEMENTS
14.
CITY MANAGER ANNOUNCEMENTS
15.
ADJOURNMENT
I hereby certify, under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.

Leticia Revilla, City Clerk
